description: Displays potentially offensive material such as profanity or nudity
examples: Products that contain pictures of live, nude models, packaging that has obscene or profane messaging
first_step: Place product in a black or opaque bag.

description: Made of cloth or fabric and intended to be put on a hanger
first_step: Remove hanger, and then place product in a transparent poly bag to protect from damage or dust.

description: Made of cloth or fabric that could be damaged by dirt, dust, moisture, or liquid
examples: Shirts, bags, belts, plush toys such as teddy bears
first_step: Place product in a transparent poly bag to protect from damage or dust.

description: Made for a child aged three years or younger, packaging with cutouts greater than one square inch
first_step: Place product in a transparent poly bag.

description: Glass or otherwise fragile, or a liquid in a glass container
examples: Glass, china, picture frames, clocks, mirrors, bottles of olive oil
first_step: Place product in bubble wrap or a bubble bag to prevent damage. Products can also be placed in a protective overbox.

description: Liquid or viscous without a double seal
first_step: Place product in a transparent poly bag to protect from leakage.

description: In packaging that has a perforated opening
first_step: Seal product in a transparent poly bag. The poly bag must include a suffocation warning.

description: Made of powder, pellets, or granular material
first_step: Seal product in a transparent poly bag. The poly bag must include a suffocation warning.

description: Sharp units are objects with an edge or point that are able to cut or pierce packaging material or human skin
examples: Knives, blades, shears, scissors, cutters, saw blades, barbed wire, hardware nails, axe/mattock, steel wire, graters, peelers, slicers, scalpels, swords, tools
first_step: No additional prep required. Instead, follow the guidelines on Packaging sharp units.

description: Longest side less than 2 1/8 inches (width of a credit card)
first_step: Place product in a transparent poly bag.

description: Multiple items that are sold as one unit
examples: Bundled items, Multi-packs, Toy sets, Case of bottled drinks
first_step: Add a label to the unit that clearly states that the products are to be received and sold as a single unit. For example, "Sold as set," "Ready to ship," or "This is a set. Do not separate."
